title: Switch
summary: The standard SwiftUI switch. Inside a Monarch theme it takes the accent colour from the tint. Monarch ships nothing.
whenToUse: For a setting that takes effect immediately.
whenNotToUse: For selecting items in a list or agreeing to terms, use the checkbox style.

states.name: on
states.description: Track in the accent colour, from the theme's tint.

appearance: System appearance in every theme; only the on-colour comes from Monarch, through the tint.
platformNotes: Android themes the Material 3 Switch and the web ships its own Switch. On iOS the system switch is the expected control, so Monarch only supplies the tint.
accessibility: System behaviour: switch role, on and off values, and the On/Off Labels setting.
edgeCases: The label uses the system body font unless monarchTextStyle is applied to the Toggle.

examples.title: Settings row
examples.setupTemplate:
@State private var first = {{items.0.checked}}
@State private var second = {{items.1.checked}}
examples.setup:
@State private var first = true
@State private var second = false

parityExceptions.reason: Apple's Toggle has one size on iOS (HIG: the system switch is not resized), so the small switch (size sm) of the second row is drawn at the system size. The row, label, description and state are the web's.
